transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I came in because I’ve been having this ongoing feeling that certain people around the arts and finance circles here in Cincinnati are kind of tracking who I meet with—like which clients—and sending me signals about it. It’ll be through things like invitations, panel topics, or even who ends up sitting near me at events.

I know, part of me says maybe it’s just coincidence, but I can’t really shake it, and it’s been hard to let go of.
How long have you been having this feeling that people are tracking who you meet with and sending you signals about it?
It’s been about two months, I’d say. That’s when I started really feeling like people were tracking my client meetings and sending those kinds of signals.
During this period, have you felt unusually energized or needed much less sleep than usual?
Not really, no. I haven’t noticed being unusually energized or going without sleep like that. My sleep’s been… maybe a little affected by stress, but I wouldn’t say I need less sleep than usual.
Have you been hearing voices or seeing things that other people don’t seem to?

No, I don’t think so. I haven’t been hearing voices or seeing things, at least not in that way. It’s more… I notice patterns or messages in what’s happening around me, but I’m not seeing or hearing things other people couldn’t.
During these past two months, have you been feeling depressed most of the day nearly every day?
I wouldn’t say depressed most of the day, nearly every day. I’ve felt stressed and worried at times, but not really depressed like that.
Before these last two months, had you ever had this same feeling that people were tracking you or sending you messages?
No, not before this. The feeling that people were tracking my client meetings or sending me signals really started about two months ago.
For at least one full month, have you had this feeling that people are tracking you or sending you messages nearly every day?
Yes. It’s been pretty much every day for about two months now, this feeling that people are tracking my client meetings or sending me messages.
Since this started, has it caused major problems in your work or in your relationships with other people?

Yeah, it has caused problems. I’m still working, but my practice has gotten smaller. I miss follow-ups sometimes, I avoid some public panels, and I’m just not keeping up the same level of contact with clients like I used to.
Have these feelings and interpretations been going on for more than three months?
No, not more than three months. It’s been about two months that I’ve had this belief that people are tracking my client meetings and sending me signals.
Since this started, have you found yourself showing much less emotion in your face or voice than usual?

Yeah, somewhat. I still get work done, but kind of in pieces. I don’t feel like I have the same spark. I’ll leave client follow-ups sitting, skip jazz nights or pickup basketball, and I don’t feel much about it. When friends ask what’s going on, I usually just give short answers because talking feels like more effort than it should.
Since this started, have other people told you that your speech is hard to follow or that your thoughts seem jumbled?

I don’t think so. No one’s really told me my speech is hard to follow or that I’m not making sense. I might be quieter or shorter with people, but I haven’t noticed my thoughts being jumbled like that.
Do you believe anyone can control your thoughts or put thoughts into your mind?

Not exactly like someone putting thoughts in my head, no. It’s more that I’m convinced certain people in the arts and finance circles here are watching who I meet with and then sending little signals—like through invitations, panel topics, or even where people sit at events. I can tell myself maybe it’s coincidence, but I can’t really shake it.
Before these last two months, did you often feel that ordinary events had special meanings meant specifically for you?

No, not really before that. This thing where I feel like people are tracking my client meetings and sending me signals… that’s been going on for about two months. Before then, I don’t think I was reading special meanings into ordinary stuff like that.
Since this started, have you done anything that other people thought was very strange or grossly disorganized?

I don’t think so. I mean, nobody’s said I was acting very strange or anything like that. I’ve maybe been more cautious or kept to myself more, but I haven’t done anything gross or really disorganized that I know of.
Do you believe these people are using any impossible or supernatural method to track you or send you messages?

No, I don’t think it’s supernatural or anything impossible. It feels more like people in those circles are paying attention to who I meet with and then hinting at it through normal things—like invitations or panel topics or where people sit near me. I know that might sound like coincidence, but I can’t really shake the feeling.
Since this started, have you had much less motivation to do everyday activities than usual?

Yeah… I think so. I still get my work done, but it’s more in chunks, and I let things sit longer than I used to—like client follow-ups. I don’t really have the same drive.

Outside work, I’ve been skipping things I normally like, like jazz nights or pickup basketball, and I don’t feel much about missing them. Even talking to friends feels like more effort, so I end up giving short answers.
Have you had the experience that your thoughts are being broadcast so that other people can know what you are thinking?

No, not exactly like that. I don’t feel like people can hear my thoughts or that my thoughts are being broadcast.

It’s more that I feel like certain people are tracking who I meet with and then sending little signals through things like invitations or event topics, or even where people sit near me. I know that could sound like coincidence, but it’s hard for me to let it go.
Since this started, have you heard voices when no one else was there?
No, I haven’t noticed anything like that. I don’t hear voices when I’m alone or when no one else is around.
Do you believe for certain that these people are deliberately sending you messages about your client meetings?

I mean… I’d say I’m pretty convinced, yes. I try to tell myself maybe it’s coincidence, but it keeps lining up in ways that feel too specific.

Like invitations, panel topics, even where people sit near me at events—it feels like they’re sending little messages about who I’ve been meeting with. I can’t really shake that.
Since this started, have there been times when you became very still or had trouble moving or speaking, even when you wanted to?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t had times where I couldn’t move or couldn’t speak when I wanted to. Maybe I get quiet if I’m stressed, but not like being stuck or frozen.
